description:
[Taxonomy VII.135 — baseline response (public data only)] Select optimal supporting documents for an appeal from an available document pool.

WHEN TO USE: User is preparing an appeal and needs a ranked list of supporting documents for the denial category. Pass denial_code.

WHEN NOT: Without denial_code — still returns generic docs but category-specific ranking is the high-value output.

EXAMPLES:
- Docs for a CO-50 medical-necessity denial: `{"denial_code":"CO-50"}`

denial_code.description: CARC denial code, e.g. 'CO-50'. Drives category-specific document ranking.

name: supporting_document_selector
